title: OL 9 must not have the sendmail package installed.
check_content:
Verify that OL 9 does not have the sendmail package installed with the following command:

$ dnf list --installed sendmail
Error: No matching Packages to list

If the "sendmail" package is installed, this is a finding.
fixtext:
Remove the sendmail package with the following command:

$ sudo dnf remove sendmail
VulnDiscussion: The sendmail software was not developed with security in mind, and its design prevents it from being effectively contained by SELinux. Postfix must be used instead.
